text:
alexa: FYI team: final prep for the Private/VPC offline crate handoff to customer Orion tomorrow 07:00 UTC. packaging passed CI but we need final sign-off on pinning + abort window. quick please.

deploy-bot: packaging run scheduled 05:30 UTC. will emit sealed crate with detached signature. planned tag: `installer-orion-v1.5.0+orion-20260323`. artifacts: installer.tar.xz, images.tar.br, submanifest.json, detached.sig

jesse: asked Orion ops what they want pinned. they prefer immutable sha256 pins in submanifest and an indexed human tag for runbook lookups. also requested a short-lived manifest TTL.

security-bot: recommendation: include both full sha256 and short 12-char digest in submanifest; include signer-attestation.pdf in `artifacts/attest/`. set manifest TTL to 14d for offline deliveries. include offline key rotation notes.

sam: release notes ready. callouts: "image set pinned to rset-20260323, quant profile: q8_0 for x86_64, canary disabled for private deliveries, healthcheck script included at bin/post-install.sh"

ops-oncall: define rollback triggers. propose: 1) installer checksum mismatch during verify 2) post-install smoke fails 3) >5% 5xx in first 15m OR KMS attestation failure. if triggered push previous bundle `installer-orion-v1.4.7` and run `evacuate.sh --from-orion`.

alexa: slightly tighten: use 5xx threshold OR degraded probe success <90% over 10m. also add forced hold before courier pickup so oncall can abort.

deploy-bot: packaging preview:
```
artifact: installer-orion-v1.5.0+orion-20260323.tar.xz
sha256: b9d2f0c4a1e8d5b6c4f2a1b8c3d9e6f5a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c2d
detached-sig: detached.sig (signer: projects/orion-kms/keys/offline-packer)
submanifest.managed: rset-20260323
```

jesse: note  the detached signature will be couriered on separate media per customer's SOP. on-site will verify checksum and sig before unseal. add explicit verify command to docs: `cosign verify-blob --key <pubkey> --signature detached.sig installer.tar.xz`

security-bot: offline signer note: do NOT include private key on crate. include public key fingerprint `AA:BB:CC:DD` and verifier steps.

alexa: timeline: packaging 05:30, courier pickup window 06:00-07:30 UTC, expected customer ingest 09:00 UTC. add a forced hold at 07:45 UTC to allow manual abort: `/deploy hold installer-orion-v1.5.0 --until 07:45`

sam: add abort command and reason template to release notes: `/deploy abort installer-orion-v1.5.0 --reason "postpack verification"` and the contact matrix.

ops-oncall: please include `docs/rollback.md` in the crate root with clear steps: verify artifact, run `./evacuate.sh --tag installer-orion-v1.4.7`, contact list. i'll add a minimal checklist.

je sse: small correction  healthcheck path is `bin/post_install_check.sh` (underscore). will update release notes.

alexa: ok folks, i'll trigger packaging in 30m unless a blocker surfaces. last call. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: packaging queued. will post final checksums and crate URL once complete.

alexa: thanks. i'll also attach chain-of-custody template to release notes and tag the ticket `private-vpc-delivery` for post-delivery audit.

sam: good. ops-oncall will standby during pickup window. ping here when courier clears the gate. :truck:
